per_question.question: Does NC Medicaid cover chiropractic services under Clinical Coverage Policy 5B?
per_question.agent_answer:
I’m going to look up Clinical Coverage Policy 5B directly, then read the policy’s scope/covered-services sections and check for any amendments before answering.I found that Policy 5B is **Orthotics & Prosthetics**, so the answer likely turns on scope rather than a chiropractic-specific subsection. Next I’m reading the policy’s scope and not-covered sections and checking whether there have been amendments.The not-covered section confirms 5B only covers services/products that meet its own criteria, but the scope text in Section 1.0 didn’t come through. I’m going one level deeper into the covered criteria and document context so I can answer the scope question cleanly.**No — Clinical Coverage Policy 5B does not cover chiropractic services as such.** Policy 5B is the **Orthotics & Prosthetics** policy, and the retrieved coverage criteria are limited to **orthotic devices** and **prosthetic devices**, not chiropractic treatment or spinal manipulation.

### Why
- **Clinical Coverage Policy 5B, Section 3.2.1 — “Specific criteria covered by Medicaid”** states that covered items under this policy are **orthotics and prosthetics** that are:
  - ordered by a physician, PA, or NP;
  - medically necessary; and
  - supported by a face-to-face encounter and ongoing review.  
  It further defines:
  - **Orthotic devices** as devices required to correct or prevent skeletal deformities, support or align movable body parts, or preserve/improve physical function; and
  - **Prosthetic devices** as devices replacing all or part of the function of a permanently inoperative, absent, or malfunctioning body part.  
  Source: [Orthotics & Prosthetics](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/5b-orthotics-prosthetics/download?attachment)

- **Clinical Coverage Policy 5B, Section 4.0 — “When the Procedure, Product, or Service Is Not Covered”** says the service is not covered when the beneficiary does not meet the criteria in Section 3.0. Since Section 3.0/3.2.1 limits coverage to orthotic and prosthetic devices and related requirements, **chiropractic services fall outside this policy’s scope**.  
  Source: [Orthotics & Prosthetics](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/5b-orthotics-prosthetics/download?attachment)

### Bottom line
If your question is specifically whether **chiropractic treatment** is covered **under CCP 5B**, the answer is **no**.  
If your question is whether a **spinal orthosis/back brace** ordered in connection with a musculoskeletal condition could be covered, that is a different question; Policy 5B does include **spinal orthoses** as a device category.

I also checked for amendments to Policy 5B and did not find any listed amendments in the knowledge base; the current authoritative document is **Clinical Coverage Policy 5B — Orthotics & Prosthetics**.
